mcq_fix.s: Shaikh Ahmad Sirhindi opposed which of the following? 1. Akbar's Sulh-i-kul 2. Akbar's Din-i-Ilahi 3. Sama 4. Visits to saints' tombs Select the correct answer using the code given below.
mcq_fix.why: sama and tomb visits are not Akbar's policies; stem wrongly called all four Akbar's initiatives

patterns: No PYQs are filed under this topic; expected APPSC shape is direct saint -> title/order/place/text items (Garib Nawaz = Moinuddin, Mahboob-i-Ilahi = Nizamuddin, Fawaid-ul-Fuad = Amir Hasan Sijzi).
Common traps from other PSCs (in notes): Fawaid-ul-Fuad distractors Amir Khusrau/Barani; Chiragh-i-Delhi = Nasiruddin; Sirhindi = Naqshbandi, Mujaddid Alf-i-Sani.
App MCQs are few and sound; they lean to multi-statement comparisons (Nizamuddin vs Sirhindi) rather than the one-line identification APPSC typically uses.
